sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Binod Kumar, Advocate

For the Opposite Party/s : Dr. Ajeet Kumar, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 2 22-05-2023 It has been brought to the notice of this Court that altogether 21 accused persons have been granted bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court.

2. From perusal of the FIR, it appears that apart from Sections 346, 370, 370A, 371, 372, 373, 376 and 120(B) of the IPC and Sections 3, 5, 6, 7 and 8 of the Immoral Traffic Act, this case has also been registered under Sections 4, 5, 12 and 17 of the POCSO Act and under Section 75 and 79 of the Juvenile Justice Act.

3. Since, the learned Coordinate Bench has already applied its mind to cases of almost all the co-accused persons, the matter needs to be placed before the same Bench after obtaining the permission of the Hon'ble The Chief Justice.

(Arun Kumar Jha, J) himanshu/-
